ITEM 1 | Three pale orange-pink fillet pieces with flaky, slightly crumbly surface and browned speckled crust, lying on a white plate; largest piece about 8 cm long by 5 cm wide and 2 cm thick, sitting at upper left and center, a third piece at lower left, moist-looking interior edges | 330
ITEM 2 | Roasted carrot pieces, bright orange with caramelized darker edges and slight sheen, cut into thick rounds about 3 cm across and 1 cm thick, clustered at center and right of plate | 95
ITEM 3 | Diced pale yellow pineapple chunks, about 2 cm cubes, glossy and moist with slight juice sheen, piled at lower right of plate | 150
ITEM 4 | Roasted red pepper pieces, deep red with charred blistered skin, irregular strips, scattered under and between the fillets | 40
ITEM 5 | Dark roasted vegetable pieces, possibly eggplant-like, dark purple-brown with soft texture, small pieces partly hidden under fillets | 25
ITEM 6 | Charred yellow-orange pieces at top right, appearing to be roasted fruit or squash with dark caramelized edges, about 4 cm across, sitting beside carrots | 35
ITEM 7 | Scattered small green flecks, finely chopped herb leaves, dark green, a few pieces at center and right edge | 3
